newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Anaconda clarifies placement statement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Anaconda clarifies placement statement.

text.p: Anaconda Nickel NL on Thursday clarified an earlier announcement to the Australian Stock Exchange regarding a placement to raise A$24.3 million.
Anaconda said it had not made any placement, save for the placement to Glencore International AG announced on October 27.
At that time, Anaconda said it placed 7.2 million shares to Glencore, raising A$24.3 million. The Appendix:3B filing for this placement was made on November 20, the company said.
"Anaconda Nickel NL is securely funded and has no reason to raise finance outside of its agreement with Glencore," it said.
